value.rationale: Natural optimization question of whether optimal identifying sensors can be moved only across physical host edges without losing identification; previously known unrestricted 28800-edge exchange graph does not determine local relocatability. The new rook slide graph loses 13824 exchange edges yet remains connected with sharp six-step distances for all pairs, and has a nontrivial two-tier local mobility profile. This completes a natural, explicitly motivated benchmark rather than a bare recitation of an old optimum-code count.
